description: Measures the download and upload speed of the internet connection of this computer, against Dten's measurement servers. Free, no account. Takes about 1 minute, up to 10 on a very slow network, and uses data in proportion to the speed: about 375 MB per direction at 100 Mbps and 3.7 GB at 1 Gbps. The record goes to Dten's archive, with no account and no name, unless DTEN_SPEED_NO_SEND=1; `dten-speed forget` deletes it. Use it only when the person asks for a measurement, and warn that it can use up a mobile data allowance. With share set to true it also returns a public link to this measurement on dten.com.br: anyone with the link sees it, and it stops working when the history is deleted. Set share only when the person asks to share the result.

direction.description: Which direction to measure. Default: both, download first.

share.description: Also return a public link to this measurement. Default: false.

name: measure_connection
